nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: Input: property_public_id, conversation_id, opportunity_id. Output: resolved, reason, failure_detail, observed_tag and validated owner. Strict tags[0]; unresolved routes to primary guard.

parameters.query:
WITH recorded AS (
  INSERT INTO public.lead_routing_events (
    opportunity_id, event_type, routing_tier, idempotency_key, metadata
  )
  SELECT $1::bigint, 'owner_lookup_failed', NULL, $2,
         jsonb_build_object(
           'reason', 'easybroker_lookup_failed_after_retries',
           'property_public_id', NULLIF($3, '')
         )
  WHERE $1::bigint IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
)
SELECT $4::uuid AS conversation_id,
       $1::bigint AS opportunity_id,
       NULLIF($3, '') AS property_public_id,
       ARRAY[]::text[] AS tags,
       NULL::text AS observed_tag,
       FALSE AS resolved,
       'owner_lookup_failed'::text AS reason,
       'easybroker_lookup_failed_after_retries'::text AS failure_detail,
       NULL::text AS owner_agent_id,
       NULL::text AS owner_name,
       NULL::text AS owner_number;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('When Called').first().json.opportunity_id || null, 'wf12:owner-lookup-failed:' + ($('When Called').first().json.opportunity_id || 'missing') + ':' + ($('When Called').first().json.property_public_id || 'missing'), $('When Called').first().json.property_public_id || '', $('When Called').first().json.conversation_id || null] }}

nodes.name: Record Owner Lookup Failure
nodes.notes: Records one idempotent technical event after EasyBroker retries fail, then returns the unresolved contract so WF10 can route the lead to guardia.
